issues.description: Identifier naming inconsistency: The method name for computing the total price of a Meal is inconsistent across artifacts. The problem statement (UML and notes) specifies a static method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal): int. The solution's SealSaloon class defines a static method named computeMealCost(Meal): int. The template Main calls computeMealCost(...), while the solution Main calls calculateTotalPrice(...). This mismatch of the method identifier will cause confusion and can lead to compilation errors or failing tests because students will not know which method name to implement/use.
issues.suggestedFix:
Unify the method name across all artifacts. Preferred options:
1) Rename the method in SealSaloon from computeMealCost(Meal) to calculateTotalPrice(Meal) and update all calls in Main(s) and any references to match. Ensure signature: public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal).
OR
2) Update the problem statement (UML and textual references) to require computeMealCost(Meal): int instead of calculateTotalPrice, and update the UML and description to match. 
In either case, ensure the method is static and returns int, and update all example usages in the Main files and documentation to the chosen name so students have a single, consistent identifier to implement.

issues.description: The exercise asks for a static method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal) on SealSaloon (problem statement UML and text), but the provided code uses a different identifier for the same concept: the SealSaloon implementation declares public static int computeMealCost(Meal) and both template and solution example code call a method with the other name. Specifically: problem statement (calculateTotalPrice), solution SealSaloon class (computeMealCost), solution Main (calls calculateTotalPrice), and template Main (calls computeMealCost). This inconsistent naming for the single concept "compute total price of a Meal" will prevent students from mapping the requirement to the implementation or tests and will cause confusion or failing references.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name across all artifacts so the conceptual operation has a single identifier. Preferred fix: rename computeMealCost(Meal) in SealSaloon to calculateTotalPrice(Meal) and update all call sites (template and solution Main) to call SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(meal). Ensure the method signature remains public static int calculateTotalPrice(Meal) and any references in the problem statement, examples, and tests match this name.
